title: QuickBooks Payroll Pricing 2024 – Online Payroll Cost vs Patriot and Alternatives
h1: QuickBooks Payroll Pricing 2024: Complete Guide to Online Payroll Cost and Alternatives
description: QuickBooks payroll pricing 2024. Compare quickbooks online payroll, intuit quickbooks payroll, quickbooks payroll cost vs patriot payroll and standalone payroll software for small business.
intro: Quickbooks payroll and intuit quickbooks payroll are the payroll processing add-ons integrated into both quickbooks online and quickbooks desktop from Intuit QuickBooks. Quickbooks payroll pricing starts at $45 per month plus per-employee fees for self-service processing, with quickbooks online payroll pricing rising to $125 per month for full-service payroll. Understanding quickbooks payroll cost versus standalone alternatives like patriot payroll is essential for any small business evaluating total accounting software expenditure. This guide covers quickbooks payroll, quickbooks online payroll, quickbooks online payroll pricing, intuit quickbooks payroll, quickbooks payroll cost, patriot payroll comparison, and why businesses using quickbooks desktop often choose to eliminate quickbooks payroll cost entirely through separate payroll providers.
